title: Deploy and bind the production execution plane
description: The Sites frontend has no authenticated HTTPS connector deployment, so production can only report the execution plane as offline.
acceptance_criteria: A TLS connector endpoint is deployed; the site environment binds to it; CORS permits only the flagship origin; authentication identifies the actor; health and execution readiness are distinct; a canary performs one real turn; rollback is documented and tested.

title: Restore green monorepo release gates
description: Root typecheck and test fail because the Tier 2 CLI imports undeclared runtime dependencies including ora, commander, and chalk.
acceptance_criteria: All CLI runtime dependencies are declared directly; clean pnpm install succeeds; root build, typecheck, and test pass from a clean checkout.
close_reason: Declared the Tier 2 CLI runtime dependencies directly. pnpm install completed, build:flagship passed 7/7, root typecheck passed 13/13, and root test passed 19/19.

title: Redesign flagship as a contextual execution surface
description:
## Problem

The current dark sci-fi HUD, fictional biofeedback, generic NOVA identity, and decorative terminal obscure the real value: context-aware orchestration.

## Product Direction

Reframe the flagship as a time-aware personal operating surface where every available action has explicit provenance, payload, and execution status.
acceptance_criteria: Remove fictional serotonin and XP metrics plus generic cyberpunk copy; present verified signals and honest unavailable states; unify commands into one power-user action bar; every primary move produces a tangible artifact, server call, or execution receipt; responsive and accessible build passes.
notes: Gemini refinement: successful receipts persist device-locally; repeated verified actions become recommended shortcuts; automation trust is expressed as explicit manual/assisted/autonomous rights with unavailable capabilities locked, not arbitrary XP.
close_reason: Flagship now uses a warm contextual execution surface with verified/unavailable signals, one command bar, real ICS artifacts, live MCP calls, provenance receipts, repeated-action shortcuts, and explicit locked automation rights; lint, build, and rendered HTML test pass.

title: Unify the Jest and Vitest integration harness
description: Remove mixed test-runner imports and private-member access from legacy integration suites.
acceptance_criteria: One documented command runs unit, audio, and WebRTC suites; no missing framework imports or private-member access; CI compiles and runs the full suite.

title: Provide a supported Node WebRTC runtime
description: Resolve the missing RTCPeerConnection runtime that currently breaks twenty WebRTC integration tests.
acceptance_criteria: A maintained Node implementation is wired or peer operations move to a documented browser boundary; all thirty WebRTC integration tests pass in CI.

title: Implement real connector-to-MCP transport bridge
description: Replace placeholder MCPClient behavior with a real browser-safe bridge to the stdio MCP Games server.
acceptance_criteria: Connector performs MCP initialize and capability discovery; load_game, start_game, make_choice, and mesh planning work through HTTP; disconnect cleans up transport resources; tests cover a real turn, timeout, and upstream failure.
notes: Gemini product critique accepted: the bridge must expose actual tool execution receipts to the flagship, not placeholder query results.
close_reason: Official MCP SDK stdio bridge now discovers capabilities and exposes allowlisted load, start, choice, and mesh execution with cleanup, deadlines, structured receipts, fake-runtime contract tests, and a real spawned-server turn; connector tests, typecheck, build, and lint pass.

title: Wire production calendar and weather context adapters
description: Complete the real context inputs required by The Morning Decision.
acceptance_criteria: Calendar and weather adapters return useful data; context permissions are enforced; timeout, denial, and provider errors use authored fallbacks; tests expose no raw placeholders.

title: MCP Games flagship and super-server readiness
description: Track the work that turns the shipped MCP Games flagship, NOVA agent console, connector, and MCP game server into a complete production system.
acceptance_criteria: All P0 children are closed; the browser plays a real server-backed game; CI proves the flagship build and container topology; remaining P1/P2 work has explicit ownership.
notes: Shipped baseline: https://mcp-games-command-center.lovelogic-ai.chatgpt.site. Detailed source ledger: docs/READINESS_LEDGER.md.

title: Harden the public execution boundary
description: The connector lacks actor authentication and rate limiting and allows wildcard CORS when no origin list is configured.
acceptance_criteria: Production CORS fails closed; authenticated actor identity reaches every receipt; routes enforce rate, concurrency, payload, and time limits; request IDs and safe errors are logged; arbitrary tool and filesystem invocation remain impossible.

title: Add approved action execution to game choices
description: Game choices currently mutate only internal variables; add typed allowlisted real-world actions with explicit approval and useful artifacts or tool calls.
acceptance_criteria: Choice actions use typed allowlisted descriptors; preview and approval are mandatory by policy; execution is idempotent; failure and rollback states are visible; receipts distinguish state mutation from external effects; at least one flagship choice completes a useful external action.

title: Build durable receipt ledger and pattern-to-automation flywheel
description: Persist verified action receipts across sessions, derive successful repeated-action patterns, and turn approved patterns into reusable automation graphs without overstating autonomy.
acceptance_criteria: Receipts are append-only and tamper-evident; executions retain tool, payload, result, duration, actor, and approval; pattern recommendations cite supporting receipts; users can promote, revoke, and constrain automation rights; autonomous execution respects explicit scopes and has rollback/audit tests.

title: Repair root Git worktree metadata without losing changes
description: Preserve the restored authoritative GitHub history and make repository operations reliable after the stale worktree pointer incident.
acceptance_criteria: Remote points to RemyLoveLogicAI/mcp-games-monorepo; recovery branch exists; git status, diff, and branch discovery work; stale pointer remains recoverable and no working-tree changes are lost.
notes: Recovered authoritative history from https://github.com/RemyLoveLogicAI/mcp-games-monorepo.git, preserved the stale pointer as .git.stale-pointer (excluded locally), rebuilt the index without touching the working tree, and created branch codex/mcp-games-flagship-readiness. Local beads.role is maintainer.
close_reason: Repository reattached safely to authoritative origin; branch, status, diff, and history now work with all changes preserved.

title: Sandbox load_game filesystem access
description:
## Problem

MCP callers can request arbitrary local paths through `load_game`.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Start the MCP Games server.
2. Invoke `load_game` with a path outside the configured games directory.
3. Observe that the server attempts to read the caller-supplied path.

## Expected

Only files beneath configured game roots are readable; traversal and symlink escapes are rejected.
acceptance_criteria: Paths are constrained to configured game roots; traversal and symlink escapes are rejected; security tests cover permitted and escape cases.

title: Add a flagship CI integration gate
description: Protect the website, connector, game server, and workspace graph as one product surface.
acceptance_criteria: CI runs build:flagship, connector HTTP tests, and site rendered-HTML tests; Turbo graph includes all three flagship services; lockfile drift fails the gate.
notes: Root build:flagship, typecheck, and test are currently green; CI still needs one Node 22 gate, lockfile enforcement, browser journey coverage, and a production-shaped connector-to-MCP canary.

title: Correct audio DSP metrics
description:
## Problem

Voice percentage, AGC gain, and processor frame statistics remain zero for representative audio fixtures.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Run `pnpm --dir packages/mcp-games-server test:integration`.
2. Inspect the three failing DSP metric assertions.
3. Observe zero values for voiced input that should produce non-zero metrics.

## Expected

Representative voiced and quiet frames produce stable, meaningful metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Representative voiced and quiet frames produce meaningful non-zero metrics; all twenty-eight audio tests pass deterministically.

title: Consolidate duplicate game models and engines
description: Unify the overlapping Story and GameDefinition contracts across the story engine, MCP server, connector, and web surface.
acceptance_criteria: One canonical contract owns definitions and runtime state; YAML and all runtime surfaces consume it; legacy types are removed or deprecated; flagship migration test passes.

title: Add session listing, resume, and optimistic concurrency
description: Make game sessions durable, discoverable, resumable, and safe under concurrent writes.
acceptance_criteria: MCP exposes list, get, and resume; stale writes are rejected or versioned; completed sessions are immutable; restart persistence test passes.

title: Choose and finish the persistence architecture
description:
## Decision

Select one durable persistence architecture for local and production game sessions.

## Rationale

The runtime currently supports in-memory and Supabase REST state while Compose provisions PostgreSQL, creating an untested operational mismatch.

## Alternatives Considered

1. Implement a PostgreSQL adapter using the existing migrations.
2. Standardize on Supabase and remove PostgreSQL from the default stack.
3. Keep in-memory storage only for explicit development mode.
acceptance_criteria: Either a PostgreSQL adapter uses existing migrations or PostgreSQL is removed from defaults; sessions survive restart; start, choice, completion, and resume have integration coverage.

title: Prove the Docker topology and actual MCP transport
description: Exercise the valid Compose configuration as a running production-shaped system.
acceptance_criteria: CI builds both service images; docker compose reaches healthy state; smoke test performs initialize, list-tools, and one real game turn; probes reflect actual readiness.
notes: Connector image now uses Node 22, bundles the built Games server plus game assets, and sets explicit stdio entry/root/workdir paths. Compose image/runtime smoke remains unverified because the local Docker/Colima daemon is unavailable.

title: Make docs and lockfiles release-truthful
description: Documentation still describes NOVA, fake stats, embedded play, and an unimplemented bridge; the site also carries npm lockfile guidance inside a pnpm monorepo.
acceptance_criteria: All READMEs describe the verified execution surface and honest offline behavior; topology and production runbooks match reality; one package-manager policy is documented and lockfile drift fails CI.

title: Make Redis telemetry resilient offline
description: Bound reconnect noise and shutdown latency when Redis is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Reconnect uses bounded exponential backoff; offline mode is quiet and documented; shutdown is deterministic; readiness policy is explicit.

title: Implement typed context transforms
description: Replace placeholder transforms with stable typed formatting for authored context queries.
acceptance_criteria: summarize, verbatim, extract_names, and extract_dates have typed output and calendar/weather/notes fixtures; raw provider JSON appears only for explicit verbatim requests.
